rules.safety_requirement: frame_info_[""] must be non-null before root_frame_info_ is assigned from it
rules.note: Indexing frame_info_ with empty key and taking .get() may yield null; no null check is linked.

rules.safety_requirement: gview_.num_nodes() must be representable as the size argument to pending_ids_.resize without overflow
rules.note: Resize length comes from gview_.num_nodes(); no bound or overflow guard is linked.

rules.safety_requirement: id must be within the valid index range of cf_info.frame_names before cf_info.frame_names[id] is accessed
rules.note: id is derived from n->id() and used directly as an index into frame_names with no linked bound check.

rules.safety_requirement: gview_.node(id) must return a non-null NodeItem before item is dereferenced
rules.note: item is aliased from gview_.node(id); no null check is linked before later dereference.

rules.safety_requirement: params_.create_kernel must be checked for failure before item->kernel is used as a valid kernel
rules.note: create_kernel result is stored in Status s and cleanup occurs on !s.ok(), but the success path use of item->kernel is not guarded by a linked check.

rules.safety_requirement: item->kernel must not be deleted more than once on the !s.ok() path
rules.note: delete_kernel is called and item->kernel is set to nullptr on the same failure path; no linked evidence of a second delete.

rules.safety_requirement: item->kernel must be non-null before item->kernel->const_tensor() is called
rules.note: item->kernel is allocated by create_kernel and may be nulled on failure; no linked null check before const_tensor().

rules.safety_requirement: frame_info_[frame_name].get() must be non-null before the resulting pointer is used
rules.note: The enter branch indexes frame_info_ by frame_name and calls get(); no linked null check on the result.

rules.safety_requirement: id + 1 must not overflow the size type used by enter_frame_info_.resize
rules.note: Resize argument is id + 1 under a size comparison; no linked overflow guard.

rules.safety_requirement: id must be within the valid index range of pending_ids_ before pending_ids_[id] is assigned
rules.note: pending_ids_ is sized from gview_.num_nodes() at line 14, but no linked bound check guards pending_ids_[id].

rules.safety_requirement: new bool[n->num_outputs()] must not be used if allocation fails or if n->num_outputs() is zero
rules.note: Array allocation length comes from n->num_outputs(); no linked zero-length or allocation-failure guard.

rules.safety_requirement: e->src_output() must be within the valid index range of outputs_required before outputs_required[e->src_output()] is assigned
rules.note: outputs_required is sized by n->num_outputs(), but no linked bound check guards e->src_output().
